Synopsis:
    The USDA is introducing measures to support the U.S. beef industry, including guaranteed loans for small meat processors and grazing access on conserved lands. This follows record beef prices driven by drought, wildfires and a 75-year low in cattle herd size. The Trump administration is simultaneously expanding lower-tariff beef imports to ease consumer prices, a move that has drawn criticism from farm groups.
